technique_name: Identify and explain the three major benefits of cloud computing.
description: Cloud computing offers three major benefits: scalability, cost savings and reliability. By migrating applications and data to the cloud, businesses are able to scale their operations easily to meet the needs of their customers. This scalability helps businesses save money on upfront investments, such as servers and equipment, that would otherwise be necessary to facilitate those operations.
